name: Juridata
description:
Juridata brings the expertise of Moroccan law into Claude. It searches case law from the Cour de cassation, legislation published in the Official Gazette, and Ministry of Justice resources — and every answer is backed by references you can verify against the source.

Built for legal professionals in Morocco — lawyers, in-house counsel, and notaries — Juridata lets you research, analyze, and draft without leaving your conversation.
What you can do:

• Search case law and legislation, with cited references.
• Get reasoned answers to questions of Moroccan law.

A pioneering African legaltech: Juridata starts with Moroccan law and is built to scale across the continent — bringing verifiable, jurisdiction-specific legal AI to a market that global tools don't cover.

Before you start: an active Juridata account is required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Juridata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Juridata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.juridata.ma/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Juridata MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Juridata provides these MCP tools: fetch_document, list_legal_categories, search_jurisprudence, and search_laws.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Juridata?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Juridata in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Juridata requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Juridata is developed by JURIDATA. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
